title: Portfolio X-Ray: one health score for your portfolio, 9 dimensions per holding
author: Effective_Manager273
selftext:
Hi all, I am Serhat and I built InvestMuse.

You paste your holdings (stocks, ETFs, crypto) and get:

\- one health score for the whole portfolio (for example B- 74/100, moderate risk)

\- a read on each holding across 9 dimensions: regime, technicals, trend, key levels, fundamentals, sector edge, news sentiment, momentum and chart patterns

\- how the same mix held up in past drawdowns like 2020 and 2022

It is free. You need a free account to see the full result (it also emails you a PDF), and with that account you can get alerts on your phone for those holdings: headlines with a strong tone and price levels you set yourself.

It is an analytics tool, not advice.
